scope.count_basis: One logical CUDA workload per source area and hardware-free label; hardware replicas and parallel shards count once.
scope.coverage_basis: At least one inline AMD mirror in current main ci; native AMD and legacy amd-ci never inflate the CUDA coverage numerator.
scope.gate_basis: Required means the configured AMD route has neither optional nor soft_fail; this is source configuration, not proof of runtime success or blocking behavior.
excluded: CPU, no_gpu, and other accelerator definitions
Explicit NVIDIA/backend-specific or temporary monitoring workloads listed in classification policy
included_but_classified: Current CUDA workloads without an AMD route remain missing unless every replica is explicitly not applicable.

rocm_inventory.count_basis: AMD routes in main ci only; native AMD workloads do not add to CUDA-to-AMD coverage.

scope.count_basis: Every AMD test group in current main ci: one row per YAML definition (inline mirror.amd declaration or native AMD step); parallelism and shards count once.

kinds.gpu_mirror: Inline mirror.amd declaration that runs on an AMD GPU
kinds.cpu_mirror: Inline mirror.amd declaration that runs CPU-only (no_gpu) on an AMD agent
kinds.native: Native AMD step (device mi*/amd_mi*) with no upstream CUDA definition

scope.coverage_note: Only GPU mirrors feed CUDA-to-AMD coverage; CPU-only mirrors and native AMD steps are inventory only.
